deliverable_spec.card: 16:10, at least 1280x800, PNG; the subject must read at 220x138 px (the picker card size on a phone)
deliverable_spec.safe_area: keep the top-left third of heroes calm and darker (or plain paper on light themes): UI text sits there

global_style: Real photography, not a render: shot like a high-end editorial or luxury-watch campaign on a full-frame camera, shallow depth of field, true reflections, physically accurate materials (toned silver with micro-scratches, gold, brass, marble, walnut, velvet, glass), soft volumetric light, rich natural grading, fine film grain. Real-looking coins or bullion in a place that fits the mood. Calm, expensive, cinematic. Exception: an image whose `medium` names an illustration, pixel art, clay or poster style is made in that medium, at the same premium standard (clean, crafted, never cheap clip-art).
negative: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no faces, no hands, no 3D-render plastic look in the photo images, no oversaturation, no HDR halos, no warped or melting coins, no invented legible inscriptions
coin_rule: Coins look like real circulated or uncirculated world coins (a generic portrait, eagle or crest is fine); never invent a legible inscription.
